metadata.description: Right-sized architecture, state, API layers, UI, visual design, motion, 3D and read-only audit tooling for Nuxt and Next.js.

plugins.name: frontend-architect
plugins.description: Two skills, a read-only reviewer agent and fifteen read-only audit scripts (parsing with the project's own TypeScript and vue/compiler-sfc; an opt-in browser mode with axe-core) for Nuxt/Vue and Next.js/React: architecture stages and modular monoliths, rendering strategies, state (Pinia, Pinia Colada, Zustand, TanStack Query), API layers (Axios, fetch), TypeScript, forms, tables, charts, i18n, auth and multi-tenancy, security, performance, observability, deployment, testing, legacy modernization, microfrontends and Nuxt Layers, design contracts and tokens, design systems in Nuxt UI and shadcn/ui, enterprise, landing and commerce UI, accessibility and visual verification, capability coordination with external design skills, GSAP and Three.js; and (1.6) performance intelligence: static performance patterns, lab Core Web Vitals, interaction latency (Event Timing) and hydration cost in the browser, per-route bundle attribution and rendering strategy, and typed performance budgets with before/after verified optimization.
